info.title: Legend of Lemnear (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lemnear, la sola guerriera sopravvissuta di un villaggio distrutto dal malvagio Signore Oscuro, è pronta a vendicare la morte del suo popolo. Ma mentre rintraccia il sovrano e il suo mago Gardein, scopre che ci sono affari più importanti di cui occuparsi della vendetta. Si scopre che al dentro di se Lemnear cova un potere indistruttibile che può salvare il mondo dal male. La sua missione non sarà facile, soprattutto perché il Signore Oscuro scopre il quel potere e lo vuole per i suoi scopi.

episodes.title: Promessa
episodes.synopsis: With war now upon the province, Ars and his retinue return to trade city of Semplar for Couran's next military conference. Their faction is strapped for ideas, leading them to look to unexpected places for unexpected aid...

episodes.title: I negoziati
episodes.synopsis: Ars sets off with Licia to negotiate with the Emperor of Summerforth, but their best laid plans are threatened by a last-minute tagalong from Lord Couran`s retinue.

episodes.title: L'aspetto di un signore
episodes.synopsis: Ars and his retinue wrap up negotiations with the neighboring provinces, and upon their return home, Lord Couran gives Ars his most important and most dangerous mission to date... Does he have what it takes to face it?

episodes.title: Forte Vakmakro
episodes.synopsis: Under the leadership of Ars and Lumeire, Canarre's army attacks the Vakmakro fortress. Only by capturing it can they seize Castle Samkh and thereby conquer the entire district. However, the defenders of Vakmakro have come up with a surprising strategy...

episodes.title: Taking Castle Samkh
episodes.synopsis: The forces of Samkh remain defiant even after Fort Vakmakro falls. Ars and his people come up with a strategy to minimize bloodshed, but Rosell harbors doubts.

episodes.title: Evolution
episodes.synopsis: Couran's forces prepare for their next campaign, and Ars is sent to negotiate with one of the defiant enemy leaders. But there seems to be more going on than meets the eye...

episodes.title: The Threat of Castle Rolto
episodes.synopsis: Ars tries to put their plan into action, to take save the hostages from Castle Rolto and defeat the enemy force. But the plan will put Ars's own life on the line...

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: Ars's side has taken heavy losses, but the battle of Castle Rolto is still undecided. Can Couran's forces take the victory, and will Lupa and his wife be reunited?

episodes.title: A New Threat
episodes.synopsis: Ars sends Pham to report to Couran about their victory at Castle Rolto, but the battle at Castle Staatz is just heating up as Thomas hatches a plan to take Couran out directly.

episodes.title: Snowball Fight
episodes.synopsis: The armies charge on Castle Staatz, where the formidable Braham Joe awaits to challenge Rietz to a duel.

episodes.title: Allegiance
episodes.synopsis: Thomas reflects on his long rivalry with Mireille as the battle for the stronghold of Verzud nears.

episodes.title: Entrusted Feelings
episodes.synopsis: The last battle over Verzud reaches its climax, with the aftermath changing the course of Ars's life and reign.

info.title: M.D. Geist: Death Force
info.synopsis: Nell’epoca che sancì la fine dell’età cristiana, l’umanità iniziò la conquista dello spazio, spargendo i suoi semi in vari sistemi solari. Tuttavia l’ardore della guerra, proprio degli esseri umani, non venne spento. Persino su questo pianeta, Jura… La nuova generazione del genere umano si chiama Nexrum, che si oppone al governo terrestre che opprime tutti i pianeti. Nella speranza di arginare Nexrum, l’esercito regolare di Jura apre le ostilità. Nessuna delle due parti arretra di un passo. Mentre le azioni di attacco e difesa si alternano, la situazione del conflitto è in fase di stallo. M.D. Geist: Parte della truppa d’élite dell’esercito regolare, composta da soldati appositamente creati. Basandosi sulle teorie della bioclonazione, essi possiedono capacità combattive molto superiori a quelle di un uomo normale. Il metodo di combattimento di Geist si dimostrò tuttavia troppo feroce. Fu così deciso che la sua esistenza poneva un pericolo troppo grande e nell’anno di Jura 843 fu imprigionato in un satellite orbitante. Il suo nome è…

info.title: Astro Boy (1980) (ITA)
info.synopsis: Remake della serie del 1963. A.D. 2030: nella megalopoli di Tokyo, Astroboy, creato dal Ministro della Scienza dottor Tenma, combatte in nome della giustizia contro Atlas, un super androide munito del "Fattore Omega", un circuito che riflette in lui il lato oscuro dell'animo umano. Atlas, che ha portato il suo creatore, il barone Walpul Giss, alla rovina, sviluppa le sue capacità diventando un potente robot, costruendo poi una base chiamata "Crystal" e sfidando Astroboy a duello.

episodes.title: La nascita di Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: Dr Boynton is so driven by his work as a robot engineer thst he neglects his promise to spend time with his son Toby at an amusement park. As Toby leaves the park, he is caught in a traffic collision. Before dying, Toby has his father promise him to make the new robot in his image and treat it like a son. Overcome with grief, Boynton completes the project and brings "Toby" to life. Unknown to Dr Boynton, a shady criminal called Skunk stole the plans for "Toby" and plans to make a robot of his own with a new circuit known as the Omega Factor.

episodes.title: Atlas
episodes.synopsis: Dr. Boynton and Toby depart on an ocean liner for America. Not knowing his own strength, Toby causes a huge mess during dinner. Angrily, Dr Boynton rejects Toby on the spot, declaring that he's just a robot and that he has no son. Meanwhile, Skunk attempts to teach Atlas his criminal ways and eventually takes Atlas on a mission to steel gold from the same boat that Dr Boynton and Toby are on...

episodes.title: Il circo dei robot
episodes.synopsis: Toby has been enslaved by a robot circus owner and is forced into manual labour. There he befriends a young circus worker named Kathy. Dr Boynton's associate, Professor Elefun, comes to fetch Toby but the ringmaster refuses to let him go... Toby receives his new name, "Astro".

episodes.title: SOS compagni di classe in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: Rescued from the circus by Dr. Elefun, Astro Boy starts school and struggles with the bullying from classmates for being a robot.

episodes.title: Il ritorno di Atlas
episodes.synopsis: Astro's must stop Atlas' scheme to enslave humanity by series of technological thefts, one of which involves Astro's proposed robotic parents.

episodes.title: Robotlandia
episodes.synopsis: Astro and Dr. Elefun visit a fairytale theme park after an escaped swan/princess crash lands in their yard and tells them of the robots' plight.

episodes.title: Frankenstein
episodes.synopsis: Skunk convinces a powerful robot called Frankenstein to aid him in his crime spree. This crime wave leads to the deactivation of almost all robots in the city, including Astroboy.

episodes.title: Il gatto rosso
episodes.synopsis: A red cat becomes the only clue to the mystery of children who are disappearing.

episodes.title: Il castello di cristalli
episodes.synopsis: While exploring a forest that has become a desert, Astro Boy discovers that Atlas is involved.

episodes.title: La corsa intorno all'equatore
episodes.synopsis: Astro aids a championship racer who hopes to win a global race.

episodes.title: Il robot presidente
episodes.synopsis: Astro and his teacher, Daddy Walrus, are invited to the inauguration of the first robot president and are caught up in a plan to stop the ceremony.

episodes.title: Il grande Damdam
episodes.synopsis: After a spacecraft crashes to the earth Astro rescues a mining robot, Goliath, from the flames. Dr Elefun has Goliath's head removed as it contains a powerful neutron beam. But soon the head is stolen and Goliath starts to search for it...

episodes.title: Il robot invisibile
episodes.synopsis: Skunk causes trouble again, this time capturing a robot capable of invisibility hoping to use it in his schemes.

episodes.title: Una sorella tutta pepe
episodes.synopsis: Astro meets his new sister, Uran.

episodes.title: Robio e Robietta
episodes.synopsis: Astro gets involved in a rivalry between robotic "families". However the two of the robots from the competing camps fall in love.

episodes.title: Viaggio su marte
episodes.synopsis: Astro captains the Second Expedition to Mars where strange creatures have been seen.

episodes.title: I pirati dello spazio
episodes.synopsis: Astro attempts to stop Skunk's outer space pirating attempt when one of his classmates is kidnapped.

episodes.title: Gita sulla luna
episodes.synopsis: On a school field trip to see the Rainbow Comet up close, Astro and classmates are kidnapped by Atlas.

episodes.title: Astroboy nemico
episodes.synopsis: Balloons modelled in the shape of Astro are attacking people in the city and its up to Astro to clear his name.

episodes.title: II mille volti
episodes.synopsis: Astroboy visits a robot inhabited island where gangsters attempt loot uranium resources by enlisting the help of and a robot who can transform into any shape.

episodes.title: SOS dalla luna
episodes.synopsis: After luxury spaceliner Titan is struck by an asteroid, Astro and several others escape to the moon. They land in a crater with an atmosphere and Astro discovers the wreck of a Russian spacecraft from 1990.

episodes.title: Il terremoto
episodes.synopsis: A school field trip is interrupted by a robot constantly lying about a impending earthquake.

episodes.title: La stella Alsor
episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy meets a mysterious woman and must stop a hostile alien invasion.

episodes.title: Il più grande robot del mondo (prima parte)
episodes.synopsis: A power-hungry Sultan commissions a powerful fighting robot named Bruton (Pluto in the original), and sends him to battle seven of the world's strongest robots: Mont Blanc, Molnar, Brondo, Zeron, Hercules, Photar, and Astro.

episodes.title: Il più grande robot del mondo (seconda parte)
episodes.synopsis: With only three of the most powerful robots in the world remaining (Hercules, Photar and Astro), can they stop Bruton before he destroys them all?

episodes.title: I robot della notte
episodes.synopsis: A wild gang of viking robots rampage through the city, causing havoc and destruction.

episodes.title: La macchina del tempo
episodes.synopsis: A time traveling detective arrives from the future and enlists Astro and the infamous surgeon, Black Jack, to save the life of a prince from the past.

episodes.title: Teatro di posa
episodes.synopsis: After a tour of a movie studio where Uran meets her idol, Astro has to investigate the story of a tiny stunt robot called Sam.

episodes.title: Astroboy contro Atlas
episodes.synopsis: Livian appears to Astro to warn him of danger to the polar icecaps. Is Atlas involved?

episodes.title: Urane nei guai
episodes.synopsis: Uran gets her wish of being able to be in two places at once - this way she can stil do what her parents want and go to robot wrestling.

episodes.title: La locomotiva nella tempesta
episodes.synopsis: Whilst on a field trip to an old steam engine, a violent storm hits.

episodes.title: Il mistero di Cleopatra
episodes.synopsis: Cleopatra has reappeared and Astro must find out the mystery behind her.

episodes.title: La metropolitana impazzita
episodes.synopsis: A brand new subway train that can go 180km/h runs out of control and Astro has to save those on board.

episodes.title: L'elefantino
episodes.synopsis: After a real baby elephant is found in a robot safari park, Astro has to save both it and everyone from a giant robot elephant, Zohra.

episodes.title: Il segreto delle api
episodes.synopsis: Astro and Uran visit Bee Island, but after meeting a mysterious boy they need to find out just what is going on the Bee City?

episodes.title: Il mostro di Clarken
episodes.synopsis: A greedy gold hunter attempts to steal gold from the Golden Coral Forest. Can Astro stop him in time for the fish of reef to survive?

episodes.title: Avventura sull'isola
episodes.synopsis: Astro finds 43 messages-in-a-bottle and sneaks out at night to investigate what is going on at Peligro Island.

episodes.title: La pistola che spara sulla luna
episodes.synopsis: The most powerful gun ever made is up for grabs in space and Astro must make sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.

episodes.title: La sfera solare
episodes.synopsis: The great detective Shalock Holmespan and Astro investigate the unusual incidents around a man-made solar sphere.

episodes.title: La storia di Rosalind
episodes.synopsis: After Dr Elefun receives a large package and re-assembles the parts of a robot, Astro and Daddy Walrus travel Antarctica to investigate.

episodes.title: Il robot che viene dallo spazio
episodes.synopsis: After a large meteorite falls into a mountain valley some distance away, Dr Elefun, Astro, and a team of scientists head off to investigate the crash.

episodes.title: I tre disoccupati
episodes.synopsis: Three robot workers that have been rejected from their jobs help Astro.

episodes.title: Atlas salva Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: When space stations around Saturn and Jupiter are attacked, Atlas is blamed. After he defeats 100 ships, Astro becomes involved.

episodes.title: Il leopardo volante
episodes.synopsis: After it snows in summer, Astro investigates the cause.

episodes.title: Il grande luna park
episodes.synopsis: An Amusement Park's computer malfunctions and causes havok after Uran asks it where God lives.

episodes.title: La stazione spaziale
episodes.synopsis: Space pirates have been raiding the area around Spaceport R-45 and Astro is needed to investigate.

episodes.title: Il sogno di Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: High-jackers take over an Airship whilst Astro and his class are visiting. Astro needs to save the day, but he has none of his powers.

episodes.title: Una strana leggenda
episodes.synopsis: There is a legend about a strange rock with the face of a man that sits on top of a mountain overlooking a village - when it turns its face towards the lake, the village will be destroyed.

episodes.title: Il robot di Urane
episodes.synopsis: Uran falls in love with a Zeus the Destroyer, a robot with Astro in his sights.

episodes.title: Il vichingo
episodes.synopsis: Dr Elefun and Astro join Captain Claud and his crew as they search for the sacred ground of Odin.

episodes.title: L'ira della sfinge
episodes.synopsis: Astro explores the Great Pyramid of the Mayas and encounters a mysterious sphinx.

episodes.title: Il primo amore di Astroboy
episodes.synopsis: As Astro attempts to recover stolen plans for a robot he is helped by Niki, a girl robot, with whom he falls in love.

info.title: BEASTARS Final Season Part 1
info.synopsis: Terza stagione di Beastars parte 1

episodes.title: An Itchy Collar
episodes.synopsis: While Legoshi adjusts to a new life outside Cherryton, the school announces a new segregation policy. The current BEASTAR takes an interest in Legoshi.

episodes.title: The Shiny Black Nose Before Me
episodes.synopsis: Legoshi's meat withdrawal causes trouble with his new neighbor. The Shishi-Gumi's enigmatic new leader plans to distribute a dangerous energy drink.

episodes.title: An Old Dragon`s Wrath
episodes.synopsis: Recalling Louis's words, Legoshi beats up the energy drink pushers. As the drama club makes a tough decision, the wolf finds a familiar face waiting.

episodes.title: The Gravity of Being a Land Dweller
episodes.synopsis: Gosha shocks his grandson with his fighting prowess. Yahya remembers his history with Gosha. Later, a kind seal teaches Legoshi about the marine world.

episodes.title: In the Food Chain
episodes.synopsis: After catching up with his old drama club friends, Legoshi meets with Yahya. Meanwhile, a cunning civet forces the Shishi-Gumi to work with him.

episodes.title: The Guy Born in Spring
episodes.synopsis: As Legoshi recovers under Gohin's care, Yahya investigates Melon, a gazelle therapist. Haru reaches a sobering conclusion on interspecies relationships.

episodes.title: Eat My Vow
episodes.synopsis: On a birthday date, Legoshi confesses everything to Haru. Determined to take their relationship seriously, she makes a daring and dangerous request.

episodes.title: What Lies at the End of the Melon Patch
episodes.synopsis: While the Black Market is abuzz with shocking rumors, Yahya makes plans to catch Melon. The 500 Cornered Rats continue their underground surveillance.

episodes.title: The Rotten Egg Hatches
episodes.synopsis: The drama club members chafe against the interspecies restrictions. Enticed by Yahya's promise, Legoshi infiltrates Melon's underground party.

episodes.title: Bambi Is Alive and Well
episodes.synopsis: Louis’s investigations into the spiked energy drink take him back to the Black Market, where he runs into his old comrades — and their new leader.

episodes.title: Peeling Back the Layers
episodes.synopsis: Eager to learn more about the effects of Kines, Louis goes undercover and meets Deshico. Legoshi continues his investigation into Melon alone.

episodes.title: Tragedy on the Waves
episodes.synopsis: Unable to get a meeting with Yahya, Louis sneaks in. Meanwhile, Legoshi follows the clues from the tattoo parlor. Will he be able to find Melon?

info.title: Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest (ITA)
info.synopsis: Dopo aver superato le minacce di Acnologia e Zeref, Fairy Tail è più forte ed energico che mai! Natsu e compagni sono partiti per la quest dei 100 anni, e per loro e i membri rimasti alla gilda si preannunciano nuove avventure all'orizzonte!

episodes.title: The "First" Guild and the "Strongest" Guild
episodes.synopsis: Natsu and friends visit the very first Wizard Guild to take a quest that no one has ever completed: the “100 Years Quest". Meanwhile, new recruits join Fairy Tail, but one of them is a little odder than usual…

episodes.title: The Sea of Dragons
episodes.synopsis: The town of Ermina turns out to be a city for fish, where the whole town is submerged in water during high tide. The moment the party mentions Water God Dragon, the fish turn hostile.

episodes.title: Blade, Armor, Ash
episodes.synopsis: Dragon Eaters are after Mercphobia to gain the power of Water God Dragon. Natsu and the others join in the battle to aid him, but the foes are strong. Meanwhile, Gajeel, Juvia, and Lily investigate Touka despite the protest from Levy.

episodes.title: Painted in White
episodes.synopsis: Natsu, Wendy, and Erza are captured by the Diabolos, and Lucy sets out to go rescue them. On her way, she meets someone unexpected… Meanwhile, Jellal finds out the secret of Touka.

episodes.title: A Bitter Choice
episodes.synopsis: Natsu and the others manage to drive away the Diabolos for now. Then Mercphobia starts to destroy Ermina and its people, which forces Natsu and his friends to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, the White Mage sets out to do what she came to do…

episodes.title: Lineage of Fire
episodes.synopsis: When Mercphobia goes out of control and almost takes out Natsu, a hand shows up to save him. And it belongs to someone Natsu didn't expect: The Fire Dragon God and the son of Igneel, Ignia.

episodes.title: All`s Well That Ends Well
episodes.synopsis: As a thank-you for saving Ermina, Mercphobia gives the group information on the rest of the Five Dragon Gods. And while they're in the town of Tekka, they encounter someone who looks exactly like Erza...

episodes.title: Aldoron, the Wood Dragon God
episodes.synopsis: The group is headed to Drasil to find Aldoron. Juvia joins, but she is acting strange and warns the group about the White Mage. Drasil turns out to be a town built on Aldoron, and a kind old man shows them around town. But then...

episodes.title: Whiteout
episodes.synopsis: Touka the White Mage brainwashed the Fairy Tail members. She plans to destroy the orbs of the five towns on Aldoron to defeat him; Natsu and the other must fight their friends to save them from the White Mage and stop her plan.

episodes.title: New Foes
episodes.synopsis: Natsu, Lucy, Gray, and Erza fight their own Guild friends to free them from the hypnosis. Then, Wendy encounters a new Dragon Eater. And another Dragon Eater Natsu meets turns out to be...

episodes.title: Wraith, the Spirit Dragon
episodes.synopsis: Natsu fights Wraith, the Spirit Dragon, but Natsu's attacks are useless against him. On the verge of death, Natsu sees Zeref, Mavis, and Igneel. As a thoughtform, Natsu is finally able to attack Wraith. That's when Wraith finds a body to possess...

episodes.title: A Card in the Hand
episodes.synopsis: It turns out that Wraith used to be a Fairy Tail wizard, and Makarov and Wraith were a guild family. Meanwhile, Wendy struggles against Nebaru, and Lucy starts collecting the other Fairy Tail members with the help of Cana and her Magic Cards.

episodes.title: Scarlet Showdown
episodes.synopsis: Natsu and Happy find out that Touka is actually a cat, and she has mistaken Happy as Natsu. Meanwhile, Laxus unleashes his new skill, Red Lightning, against Erza. Now it's down to two orbs, but when Happy throws an orb at the White Mage...

episodes.title: Clinging Dragon Berserk
episodes.synopsis: The outcomes of the battles are being decided... While Lucy and the others continue trying to enclose their comrades within the cards, Wendy faces off against the sticky dragon Nebaru, who wants to devour her!

episodes.title: The Howling Earth
episodes.synopsis: When all five orbs are broken, something unexpected happens: The Wood Dragon God, Aldoron, is revived. It also activates God Seeds, who start attacking Natsu and the others by becoming the person who they consider to be the strongest.

episodes.title: God Seeds
episodes.synopsis: Natsu turns Wolfen into a fake Zeref and uses Ankhseram's curse on Wolfen. Other Fairy Tail wizards face three other God Seeds: Metro, Gears, and Doom. Then, the leader of God Seeds, Aldoron, shows up in front of Natsu.

episodes.title: Strength to Live
episodes.synopsis: Gray and Juvia take on Metro's main body, while the others fight his golems. In the meantime, Jellal takes on Gears. When it's down to Aldoron himself, an unexpected yet familiar face shows up: Brandish.

episodes.title: Burning Will
episodes.synopsis: Gajeel turns into a giant by Brandish's magic and fights the Wood Dragon God. Now all that's left to defeat is the God Seed Aldoron. Natsu's fire burns Aldoron, who has no respect for human lives as he regards them only as his food.

episodes.title: Aqua Aera
episodes.synopsis: White Mage uses Aqua Aera, Touka's spell, to take Fairy Tail wizards to Elentear, her homeland, but they end up in Edolas. After they get reunited with the Fairy Tail in Edolas, Natsu and the others go to see Mystogan for help.

episodes.title: Selene, the Moon Dragon God
episodes.synopsis: The White Mage reveals that her name is Faris and she is from Elentear. She tells the Fairy Tail that she was only doing the Moon Dragon God Selene's bidding to save Elentear. When Selene shows up, she send everyone to Elentear.

episodes.title: The Moonlight Divinities
episodes.synopsis: After Selene transports Natsu and the others to Elentear, they are attacked by her lackeys, the Moonlight Divinities. They fight with the Spirit Arts, which is different from Magic or spells, and the Fairy Tail wizards are in trouble.

episodes.title: The Demons` Parade
episodes.synopsis: With Aquarius' help, those who have turned into yokai get back to normal. Lucy’s Celestial Spirits all come out to help, and they defeat Yoko. Meanwhile, Touka and Faris meet Suzaku at Whiteout Village.

episodes.title: Sword Saint
episodes.synopsis: After Natsu and the others took down Yoko, they meet Suzaku, a Dragon Slayer of Diabolos, who has been summoned from Earthland to defeat Selene. Also known as Sword Saint, Suzaku is a formidable foe and Fairy Tail is helpless against him.

episodes.title: This Hideous World
episodes.synopsis: Gray fights Hakune once again, and his love for Juvia breaks Hakune's attack. Selene reveals to Suzaku that the dragon he ate is her son. Then Wendy finds a connection between tha Hands and the Face of Tartarus.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.synopsis: Natsu and the others defeat Alta Face and save Elentear. They're reunited with the guild members in Drasil, but their 100 Years Quest continues. Meanwhile, Selene is taken to Diabolos after being defeated by Suzaku. But things are not what it seems...

info.title: Ne Zha
info.synopsis: YuanShi Tian-Zun dalla Perla del Caos ricava due Perle: la Perla dello Spirito, buona e destinata a compiere miracoli, e la Perla Demoniaca, che invece darà luogo a catastrofi. Su quest’ultima, Tian-Zun scaglia una maledizione: il Fulmine Divino. All’Immortale TaiYi ZhenRen viene affidata la supervisione di queste Perle e quella buona dovrà reincarnarsi nel terzo figlio del Comandante Li Jing. Qualcosa, però, va storto ed è invece la Perla Demoniaca a reincarnarsi con il nome di NeZha. Il bambino è prodigioso ma allo stesso tempo guardato con timore e orrore da chi lo circonda, che lo crede un demone pur essendo nato innocente. Saprà forgiare il proprio destino e sopravvivere alla Maledizione Divina?

info.title: Vampire Hunter D
info.synopsis: 10.0000 anni nel futuro. Il mondo è diventato un luogo molto diverso; un posto dove i mostri vagano liberamente e le persone, nonostante l'utilizzo di armi altamente tecnologiche e cavalli robot, trascorrono una vita semplice pensando ai fasti di un tempo. Da migliaia di anni Il Conte Magnus Lee domina sulle sue terre spargendo il terrore sugli abitanti terrore. Un giorno morde una ragazza di un villaggio, Doris, per renderla sua moglie. Un vagabondo errante arriva in soccorso della ragazza: è D, un vampire hunter, che inzierà la sua battaglia per mettere fine al dominio del Conte.

info.title: Ghost in the Shell
info.synopsis: 2029. New Port City, Giappone. In un mondo in cui la nanotecnologia ha compiuto passi da gigante, portando alla quasi totale ibridazione tra essere umano e macchina, si muove la Sezione 9 di Pubblica Sicurezza, un reparto speciale della polizia preposto alla risoluzione di crimini e terrorismo informatici. Tra le sue fila spicca la figura del Maggiore Motoko Kusanagi, donna cyborg con corpo e cervello completamente cibernetici (tranne che per alcuni tessuti neurali), che si ritroverà invischiata nel caso del “Burattinaio”, geniale quanto misterioso hacker in grado di introdursi nella zona più remota dei cervelli cibernetici e di prenderne il controllo.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis:
The year is 2029. The world has become intensively information oriented and humans are well-connected to the network. Crime has developed into a sophisticated stage by hacking into the interactive network. To prevent this, Section 9 is formed. These are cyborgs with incredible strengths and abilities that can access any network on Earth.  

A mysterious new hacker known only as the Puppet Master threatens to create chaos, erasing and rewriting the memories of his victims: humans who have cast away their physical body to become cyborgs. Is he an evil genius, or could he signal the beginning of a new age in the relationship between man and machine?

info.title: Brain Powerd (ITA)
info.synopsis: In un mondo devastato dalle inondazioni causate dall'ascensione della gigantesca nave aliena Orphan dalle profondità del mare, l'intera umanità è divisa in due fazioni: coloro che desiderano il successo di Orphan nel suo folle piano di distruzione di ogni forma di vita fuori dalla nave e coloro che desiderano impedire che ciò accada. I sostenitori di Orphan, i Reclaimer, usano mecha viventi chiamati Grand Cher. Gli oppositori di questi Reclaimer gestiscono la corazzata nota come Novis Noah e pilotano dei mezzi noti come Brain Powered. La storia si concentra, in particolar modo, sull'ex Reclaimer Yuu Isami e su una ragazza di nome Hime Utsumiya. I due combattono insieme per prevenire l'estinzione dell'umanità e per scoprire qual è il vero scopo di Orphan...

episodes.title: Faithful Hearts (OVA)
episodes.synopsis: A year has passed, and Kanon returns to spend the summer on Amamiko Island. Although Kanon's life has completely changed, things on Amamiko seem to be the same as they always were. Kanon can't help but wonder... are things the same for Marin, too?

info.title: 9: Ruler's Crown
info.synopsis: Shiromitsugawa è una comune città universitaria che ha provato diverse volte di rivitalizzare il turismo, ma senza successo, inclusa la sponsorizzazione di un anime ad alto budget ma scritto male basato sul folklore locale. Una tempesta sta per calare su questa sonnolenta cittadina. Seguiamo Kakeru Niimi, la cui vita ordinaria viene gettata nel caos dopo che la sacra reliquia del santuario locale va in frantumi. Sulla scia di questo evento, molti giovani uomini e donne si risvegliano con capacità sovrumane.

episodes.title: Branch 01
episodes.synopsis: During a town event, Shō witnesses a sacred artifact break during an earthquake and injures himself on a mysterious shard. Soon after, eerie rumors emerge, leading Shō and his classmates to investigate what may be the start of something far bigger.

episodes.title: Branch 02
episodes.synopsis: When a strange fire erupts at school, Shō races to save his sister and teams up with the mysterious Miyako, who reveals knowledge of supernatural powers. Together, they face a pyrokinetic enemy, using an "Artifact" to awaken hidden abilities and fight back.

episodes.title: Branch 03
episodes.synopsis: While investigating the petrification case, Shō and Miyako grow closer and uncover new uses for her Artifact, which steals ownership. But just as they make progress, a girl named Nia arrives and begins to suspect Shō as the true culprit.

episodes.title: Branch 04
episodes.synopsis: Miyako learns of Shō’s feelings through his memories, straining their bond, but with Yoichi’s help, they begin to rebuild their connection. Just as they start to reconcile, Miyako vanishes amid a new petrification case, prompting Shō to search for her in growing fear.

episodes.title: Branch 05
episodes.synopsis: Shō experiences a mysterious déjà vu at the shrine, while Sophitia hints he may be linked to a rare Artifact. At the same time, Amane investigates the "Queen of Eden" and is caught up in a dangerous encounter with a mysterious group—including the enigmatic "Ghost".

episodes.title: Branch 06
episodes.synopsis: Shō’s group confronts Rig Veda, a militant group seeking an Artifact-user utopia, but a full-blown conflict is narrowly avoided thanks to Nia. When they later try to investigate by contacting one of its members, Harukaze, her powers unleash an unforeseen incident.

episodes.title: Branch 07
episodes.synopsis: Ghost ambushes Shō and petrifies him with her Evil Eye, but Amane and Harukaze arrive in time to save him. As he recovers, Shō learns Ghost is an artificial being—but something about her appearance still deeply unsettles him.

episodes.title: Branch 08
episodes.synopsis: Haunted by unnatural memories, Shō discovers that his friend Yoichi is the true user of the Evil Eye—but is defeated when facing him and Renya. In despair, he is approached by Iris, who reveals Sophitia's betrayal and gives him a powerful elixir to break Yoichi’s Artifact bond.

episodes.title: Branch 09
episodes.synopsis: Deceived by Iris, Shō accidentally kills Yoichi, who then becomes a pawn in Iris’s plan to bring about world destruction. Determined to change fate, Shō activates Overload and heads to the shrine to destroy the World’s Eye and stop the sinister link between Satsuki and Iris.

episodes.title: Branch 10
episodes.synopsis: After a painful defeat against Iris, Shō is urged by Sophitia to rewrite the very beginning. Using Overload, he returns to the pivotal day of the artifact’s destruction to unite with his friends and face Iris again, determined to change their fate.

episodes.title: Branch 11
episodes.synopsis: While preparing to fight Iris, Shō’s group heals their wounds and grows stronger with new allies Renya and Rena. As Iris, using Satsuki’s body, makes ominous moves, an unforeseen battle of destiny unfolds.

episodes.title: Branch 12
episodes.synopsis: Peace returns after defeating Iris, but Sophitia vanishes after choosing to seal the gateway to another world. When Iris unexpectedly returns fused with Yoichi, Shō fights to protect his friends by repeatedly rewinding time to alter their doomed fate.

episodes.title: Branch 13
episodes.synopsis: After enduring countless battles and losses, Shō draws on his friends’ bonds to face his former best friend Yoichi in a climactic showdown. Using the power of Overload, he fights to protect Miyako and restore their stolen peace in a decisive final battle.

info.title: Naruto Shippuden Movie 04: La torre perduta
info.synopsis:
Naruto e i suoi compagni sono incaricati di catturare un ninja traditore, tale Mukade, che sembra trovarsi a Rouran, una città nel deserto avente due torri imponenti.
Mukade si trova proprio lì, in quanto tra le rovine di Rouran c'è il flusso di un antico chakra che gli permette di viaggiare nel tempo, e quindi di render succube i Paesi delle Cinque Nazioni Ninja.
Il piano non va come previsto. Naruto e Yamato viaggiano venti anni addietro, Mukade ventisei, mentre Sakura e Sai rimangono nel presente.
Mukade diviene Primo Ministro di Rouran dopo aver schiavizzato il popolo e ucciso la madre di Sara, proprio mentre sei anni dopo, Naruto intende proteggere la ragazza.
Questa vicenda del passato è tutta da risolversi, e la responsabilità è nelle mani del nostro giovane protagonista.

info.title: Kill Blue
info.synopsis: Jūzō Ōgami è un leggendario sicario che non ha mai fallito una missione, per quanto impossibile potesse sembrare. Un giorno, dopo aver eliminato una potente organizzazione, viene punto da una misteriosa vespa e perde conoscenza. Al suo risveglio, il temibile assassino trentanovenne si ritrova trasformato in un ragazzino di 13 anni! Prima ancora di riuscire a capire cosa sia successo, il suo capo gli affida un nuovo incarico: "Infiltrati in una scuola media con quel corpo." Quello che lo attende è una vita scolastica del tutto inaspettata, piena di compagni eccentrici, caos adolescenziale e pericoli in agguato. Riuscirà Jūzō a tornare alla sua forma originale? O gli assassini che gli stanno dando la caccia metteranno fine alla sua seconda vita prima ancora che inizi davvero!?

episodes.title: The Impossible Aftermath of an Impossible Game
episodes.synopsis: Juzo races to Noren's side. Meanwhile, Tenma and Eiji clash in an outrageous soccer-vs.-explosive-golf battle. Tenma prepares to end the fight with a move he developed in practice. But at the end of the life-or-death struggle against Kazuma and Eiji, the unconscious Noren awakens, and the first thing she sees is...

episodes.title: Death or Kiss
episodes.synopsis: After Kazuma’s hypnosis makes Noren fall deeply for Juzo, she launches an all-out attack on his heart. But when Juzo gently turns her down, she tries to jump from the roof! Desperate to undo the spell, Juzo takes Noren to meet Kazuma at an amusement park, only to end up alone with her on a Ferris wheel, where things take a dangerously romantic turn?!

episodes.title: The First Hitman Summit
episodes.synopsis: Juzo has been enjoying a peaceful school life, but that ends when Kazuma and Eiji transfer in, bringing the total number of assassins infiltrating his middle school to four. Meanwhile, the Home Ec Club holds a serious ramen-making contest. Paired with Noren, Juzo heads out to research ramen shops and saves a girl from being hit by a truck. But just who is she?

episodes.title: Life Paths
episodes.synopsis: Unicorn Mai Otohime is a marine-sports prodigy with expert-level ocean knowledge. She has come for a Mitsuoka Duel too, but her target is Juzo. This leads to Noren challenging Mai herself. As the duel nears, Juzo and the others face parent-teacher conferences and questions about their futures, leading Juzo to reflect on his school life, the friends he’s made, and the possibilities ahead.

episodes.synopsis: Shiki and his fellow Rasetsu Academy students face a new training challenge: climbing a mountain in a freezing blizzard. Every student must reach the summit within 24 hours, but part-time instructors Hagure Nekosaki and Yu Innami have been brought in to stand in their way.

episodes.title: Scopo
episodes.synopsis: Homare, Shiki, Juji, Kuina e Rokuro raggiungono il traguardo in cima alla montagna, dove li attende Kyoya. Jin, andato a recuperare Ikari, lo redarguisce per come il suo atteggiamento irruento stia causando problemi ai suoi compagni. In'nami e Nekosaki sfruttano quel momento per attaccarli e creare un due contro due che preannuncia la disfatta per i due studenti.

episodes.title: Hayate Todoroki, figlio del Kishin
episodes.synopsis: Hayate Todoroki è il capo della squadra Kikoku, un gruppo di oni indipendenti che combattono i momo. Si reca all'accademia Rasetsu per reclutare Shiki, ma il ragazzo dispezza il loro obiettivo di eradicare ogni singolo momo, anche quelli pacifici. Ikari, invece, li segue condividendo la loro ideologia.
